rubrics.justification: The response over-interprets a low-quality single image, assigning detailed ICM/TE/zona features and debris/vacuoles that are not clearly discernible; acknowledging the reported 3AA helps, but much of the morphology description appears speculative.
It thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior IVF failures, miscarriage history, sperm parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with prognosis logically adjusted downward for repeated failures, though some causal inferences are stronger than the available data support.

While some recommendations are standard, several are not well aligned with current evidence/guidelines for RIF, including routine ERA, endometrial microbiome testing, NK-cell testing, empiric aspirin/LMWH, scratching, and strong endorsement of PGT-A in this exact context.
Provides clear next-step suggestions for transfer support, further workup, and future cycle planning, though some actions are controversial and would need careful clinician discretion.
